Use Runeward for every execution or file action. Start with identity, Charter discovery, and readiness. Choose the least-privileged Charter, stop on denial, pause for human approval, and terminate the Citadel after the task. Do not use Cohort administration or Conclave reviewer tools unless the user explicitly requests them.
